key_insight: Fully fine-tuning a pretrained TimeSformer video model outperformed classifier-only tuning and a 3D CNN baseline for HFrEF classification from echocardiography.
clinical_relevance: Video foundation models could support echocardiography-based identification of heart failure with reduced ejection fraction, but clinical utility remains unestablished.
method: Fine-tuned TimeSformer on RVENet apical four-chamber echocardiography videos.
Used phase-aware clips to capture complementary systolic and diastolic dynamics.
Applied divided space-time attention, layer-wise learning-rate decay, and multi-clip inference.
evidence_signal: Evaluation on the public RVENet A4C dataset favored full fine-tuning, but the abstract reports no numerical performance metrics or external validation.
watch_item: Generalizability across clinical sites and patient populations requires external validation before clinical use.
paper_title: Domain adaptation of a video Foundation model for Heart Failure Diagnosis from Echocardiography
